name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Setup Node 24
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Type check
        run: pnpm typecheck

      - name: Format check
        run: pnpm format:check
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Unit tests
        run: pnpm test:run -- tests/unit
        env:
          # E2E tests need ANTHROPIC_API_KEY which is a repo secret
          # Unit tests do not.
          NODE_ENV: test

name: lint

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Setup Node 24
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Prettier check
        run: pnpm exec prettier --check 'src/**/*.ts' 'tests/**/*.ts'

# litellm-agent-runtime

Long-running daemon that lives inside a per-Session VM and drives the coding-agent loop for the LiteLLM Cloud Agents product (Cursor SDK on LiteLLM). Tracks Linear epic [LIT-2879](https://linear.app/litellm-ai/issue/LIT-2879).


## Status

| Wave | Scope | Status |
|------|-------|--------|
| Wave 1 | Scaffold + tools (read/edit/shell/grep/glob/todo) + git clone + `gh pr create` + e2e single-run-creates-PR test | in this PR |
| Wave 2 | Cursor harness (`.cursor/skills`, `.cursor/hooks.json`, `.cursor/mcp.json`); warm-pool SIGUSR1 hydrate handler; multi-run within a Session | follow-up |
| Wave 3 | Validations 5–11 (skills, hooks, MCP, per-team secrets, network allowlist, daemon restart resilience, warm mode) | follow-up |

## 3-layer extension model (LIT-2879 architecture)

The daemon ships **generic**. Customer-specific behavior is layered on top:

1. **Per-repo (Layer 1)** — `.cursor/skills/`, `.cursor/hooks.json`, `.cursor/mcp.json` in the cloned repo. Auto-detected at session start.
2. **Per-team (Layer 2)** — `LiteLLM_AgentVMConfig` + `LiteLLM_AgentSecret` in the proxy DB, written from the Settings UI. Surfaced via the hydrate payload at session start.
3. **Per-session (Layer 3)** — `repos`, `env_vars`, `agent_config` from the SDK call to `agent.createSession()`. Surfaced via the hydrate payload too.

If you find yourself adding code like `if (sessionId.startsWith("shin"))`, **stop**. Push the customization into one of those 3 layers instead.

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  EC2 VM (per Session)                                       │
│                                                             │
│  systemd unit: litellm-agent-runtime.service                │
│       │                                                     │
│       ▼                                                     │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  daemon (Node.js)                                    │  │
│  │                                                      │  │
│  │  modes/session.ts (cold-boot)                        │  │
│  │    1. POST /v2/sessions/{sid}/internal/register      │  │
│  │    2. clone repos to /workspace                      │  │
│  │    3. loop: poll next run -> run loop -> emit events │  │
│  │                                                      │  │
│  │  loop/run_loop.ts                                    │  │
│  │    LLM (Anthropic via LITELLM_BASE_URL/v1) + tools   │  │
│  │                                                      │  │
│  │  tools/{read_file,str_replace,shell,grep,glob,todo}  │  │
│  │  git/{clone,branch,pr}                               │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                  │ HTTPS + Bearer JWT
                  ▼
            ┌──────────────────┐
            │  LiteLLM proxy   │
            └──────────────────┘
```

## Running locally for tests

```bash
cd litellm/agent-runtime
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
```

The e2e test (`tests/e2e/fix-typo.test.ts`) makes a real Anthropic call (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` from `.env`) but mocks the proxy, the cloned repo, and `gh pr create` — so it can run without a live VM or real GitHub repo.

## Daemon ↔ proxy protocol

These four routes (defined in `litellm/proxy/agent_session_endpoints/internal_endpoints.py`) are the daemon's entire surface to the proxy:

| Verb / path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `POST /v2/sessions/{sid}/internal/register` | "I'm alive" — flips session `provisioning -> ready` |
| `POST /v2/sessions/{sid}/internal/heartbeat` | every 30s; bumps `last_heartbeat_at` |
| `GET  /v2/sessions/{sid}/runs/next/internal/poll` | long-poll for the next queued run |
| `POST /v2/sessions/{sid}/runs/{rid}/events:append` | stream events; terminal events flip run status |

All authenticated with the session-scoped JWT minted at session create.
